title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Robotic Systems
description:
Agile Robots SE is an innovative company with a clear mission: bringing intelligent robotic solutions to our customers. We combine the latest technology in the field of AI with powerful robotic systems — from industrial robot arms and mobile manipulators to humanoids — to solve tasks that classical automation cannot address.

Our solutions are deployed with international customers across a wide range of industries. Seamless integration and scalable deployment are at the core of our mission. Every one of these solutions starts as physical hardware — robotic workcells that we design, build, and commission in our own labs before they go into production.

We are looking for a passionate Senior Mechanical Engineer for Robotic Systems to turn robotics concepts into reliable physical systems. In this role, you will design the mechanical parts of our workcells, build and assemble them in our labs, and make sure they meet the relevant safety standards. You will own our lab infrastructure, tooling, and material, and be the hands-on partner for our robotics, software, and application engineers. The role is based in Munich, Germany.

Responsibilities

  • Design mechanical parts, fixtures, grippers, mounts, and enclosures for the robotic workcells in our labs and in customer projects
  • Validate workcell and production line concepts in simulation — reachability, collisions, and cycle times — before any hardware is built
  • Construct, assemble, and commission complete robotic workcells — from the frame and mounting concept to cabling and final integration
  • Create and maintain CAD models, technical drawings, and bills of materials, and prepare parts for manufacturing via CAM and 3D printing
  • Build up a library of reusable mechanical modules, standard components, and design templates, and feed lessons learned from existing workcells back into it, so that each new cell is faster to design than the last
  • Own the organization of our labs, including tools, equipment, material stock, and the procurement of mechanical components
  • Ensure that our workcells adhere to the relevant machine safety norms and support risk assessments, safeguarding concepts, and technical documentation
  • Work closely with robotics, software, and application engineers to translate application requirements into robust mechanical solutions
  • Travel to customer and deployment sites to support the installation, commissioning, and on-site adaptation of workcells (up to 20% of working time)

Essential Skills

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience, e.g. a technical apprenticeship with several years of relevant work
  • Minimum of four years of professional experience in mechanical design, machine building, or industrial automation
  • Solid CAD skills (e.g., SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Inventor, Creo) for part and assembly design including technical drawings
  • Experience with robot simulation and offline programming environments (e.g., RoboDK, RobotStudio, Visual Components)
  • Practical experience with CAM and common manufacturing processes (milling, turning, sheet metal) as well as with 3D printing, including design for manufacturability
  • Experience with aluminum profile systems, linear axes, fixtures, and standard mechanical components
  • Experience with robotic hardware (robot arms, grippers, cameras, AGVs, sensors, etc.)
  • Hands-on mindset — you enjoy building, assembling, and commissioning hardware yourself
  • Knowledge of machine safety norms and a structured approach to safe workcell design
  • Structured and independent working style with a strong sense of order in the lab
  • Fluency in English

Beneficial Skills

  • Knowledge of electrical engineering: wiring, control cabinets, and the integration of sensors and actuators
  • Experience with pneumatics: valves, cylinders, vacuum grippers, and air supply
  • Familiarity with functional safety standards and safety equipment (e.g., EN ISO 10218, ISO/TS 15066, EN ISO 13849, safety scanners, light curtains, emergency stop circuits)
  • Experience working with external manufacturing suppliers and in procurement
  • Basic programming skills (e.g., Python) or experience with PLC programming
  • German language skills

 

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly. 

This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!

We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
Agile Robots SE is an innovative company with a clear mission: bringing intelligent robotic solutions to our customers. We combine the latest technology in the field of AI with powerful robotic systems — from industrial robot arms and mobile manipulators to humanoids — to solve tasks that classical automation cannot address.

At the heart of our offering is a versatile software platform for orchestrating complex robotic systems. It allows efficient customization for specific customer requirements: configuring systems, developing reusable skills, parameterizing processes, and executing tasks reliably in production. Learned models — from perception to end-to-end policies — are a core part of this platform.

Our solutions are deployed with international customers across a wide range of industries. Seamless integration and scalable deployment are at the core of our mission.

We are looking for a passionate Forward Deployed AI Engineer to bring state-of-the-art robot learning and computer vision models into real production environments. In this role, you will train, fine-tune, and deploy AI models directly on customer robots — from Vision-Language-Action models and diffusion policies to perception and grasp generation networks. You will become a trusted technical partner, turning customer challenges into robust, data-driven robotics applications. The role is based in Munich, Germany.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy, fine-tune, and evaluate AI models on real robotic systems at customer sites — including Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, diffusion policies, and other end-to-end learned policies
  • Adapt and train perception models for robotic applications, e.g. object detection, segmentation, and pose estimation based on YOLO, SAM, vision transformers, and self-supervised backbones such as DINOv2

  • Work closely with customers to understand technical requirements and translate them into robust, AI-driven robotics applications
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve model, software, and system integration issues both remotely and on-site
  • Travel to international customer sites for workshops, deployments, training, and technical support (up to 40% travel)

Essential Skills

  • Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience
  • Minimum of four years of professional experience in machine learning, AI for robotics, or computer vision
  • Hands-on experience working with real robots — robot arms, mobile manipulators, grippers, cameras, and sensors — not only in simulation

  • Strong programming skills in both Python and C++
  • Solid command of machine learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and the full model lifecycle: data curation, training, evaluation, and deployment
  • Experience with modern computer vision models such as YOLO, SAM, vision transformers, and self-supervised backbones (e.g., DINOv2, CLIP)
  • Experience with learned grasp generation for manipulation (e.g., GraspNet, Dex-Net, or comparable approaches)
  • Good understanding of robot (inverse) kinematics, coordinate transformations, and hand-eye calibration
  • Experience working in Linux environments
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt quickly in customer environments

  • Good understanding of classical computer vision (e.g., OpenCV, PCL, camera calibration, point cloud processing)
  • Experience optimizing inference (e.g., TensorRT, ONNX, quantization) and deploying on NVIDIA embedded platforms (e.g., Jetson Orin, AGX, Xavier)
  • Experience with MLOps tooling: experiment tracking, dataset versioning, and continuous training or evaluation pipelines

title: Senior Infrastructure Solutions Engineer
description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role: 

A Senior Infrastructure Solutions Engineer makes Planet's infrastructure easier to use. Infra Solutions is a small, multi-disciplinary team: engineers who are as comfortable operating a system as building one, and as comfortable in a hard conversation as in a code review. We sit between the teams who build Planet's platform capabilities and the teams who need them, and our market is every engineering team at Planet, which we earn one engagement at a time. Teams work with us because we make their week lighter, not because anyone told them to, and every team that lands on the platform is infrastructure Planet no longer has to duplicate, secure and pay for.

Most of what you do takes the shape of a hands-on engagement with a team that is blocked, mid-migration, or arriving on the platform for the first time. They usually arrive with a proposed solution rather than the problem behind it, and working out the difference is where the engagement starts. From there you own it end to end: the diagnosis, the hands-on fix, the argument for what should change upstream, and the durable artifact that stops the next team hitting the same wall. This is a role driven by unreasonable hospitality (value out of proportion to what anyone asked us for) and backed by solid engineering and operator depth. You have run things in production, and you write the code other engineers depend on. The ideal candidate is energized by other teams' success: someone who would rather ship the thing that makes ten teams faster than own a system outright, and who does their best work in a room they don't own, with people who are not yet convinced they need help.

This is a full-time, remote position based in Germany, the Netherlands or Slovenia. If located near a Planet office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Lead end-to-end technical engagements: Partner directly with engineering teams to diagnose, unblock, and resolve complex infrastructure challenges.
  • Execute critical migrations: Develop reference implementations, tooling, and guidance to transition teams off deprecated systems seamlessly.
  • Accelerate platform adoption: Act as the primary technical contact for new teams onboarding to Planet’s core infrastructure.
  • Establish standardized paths: Consolidate disparate solutions into well-supported, paved-road infrastructure offerings.
  • Build scalable, shared artifacts: Design re-usable libraries, Terraform modules, and Helm charts to solve recurring technical patterns across teams.
  • Enhance platform observability: Implement instrumentation and attribution tooling to provide visibility into infrastructure cost, usage, and adoption.
  • Inform platform strategy: Synthesize engineering feedback and common pain points to influence the broader infrastructure roadmap.

What You Bring:

  • 6+ years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering, including experience leading at least one cross-team project or migration.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
  • Background in technical enablement, developer experience, or solutions architecture with a focus on internal developer productivity.
  • Hands-on experience operating and maintaining production infrastructure environments.
  • Deep expertise with Kubernetes orchestration, including workload optimization and operations.
  • Working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or other public cloud providers, including its compute, storage, quota, and capacity mode.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Proficiency in software development using Go or Python.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous requirements into structured, actionable engineering tasks.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and cross-functional collaboration.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Experience with large-scale block storage (Persistent Disk, Hyperdisk, Ceph, SAN, or equivalent) operated at fleet scale rather than per-service.
  • Experience driving large-scale migrations or deprecations that required buy-in from teams outside your reporting line.
  • Experience in a consulting-adjacent engineering role (solutions architecture, professional services, or technical account engineering) applied to an internal platform.
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration (e.g. Temporal), batch and job-execution systems, or large-scale data processing pipelines.
  • Experience defining and measuring platform adoption: developer-productivity instrumentation, NPS, or internal marketshare.
